caption: The video captures a close-up, shallow-focus view of a lit sparkler held upright in the right-center of the scene. Its burning point glows white-hot, with a reddish coiled wire above it and a thin stick below. Bright sparks emit radially from the glow, their direction and length continually shifting. The blackened coil above the glow lengthens from a short stub into a taller squiggly line over time. Thin wisps of smoke grow more prominent, drifting upward and to the left of the burning tip. The blurred background remains largely unchanged, showing a dark vertical post, a bright circular bokeh on the left, and a pale wall with a horizontal seam on the right. The sparkler stays essentially steady, with only slight positional variation.
relations: The white-hot burning point emits radial sparks whose direction and length continually shift during combustion.
The blackened coil above the glow lengthens from a short stub into a taller squiggly line over time.
Thin smoke wisps grow more prominent and drift upward and left of the burning tip as it burns.
The upright sparkler stays essentially steady with slight positional variation while the blurred background remains largely unchanged.
